Reviewer: MacBook-Pro pool job review-4443, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** One blocker. Newer `main` causes it, not the post logic.

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR adds a post, so it changes posted G-code.

## What looks good

- `fluidnc.cps` is `grbl.cps` with a small, clear diff. I read the full diff. Only comments, refusal texts, the header note and the description change. No G-code word changes.
- I read each new golden against its `grbl` twin, line by line (`diff -r`):
  - `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/fluidnc/*.nc` (12 files) and `synth_fluidnc.nc`: the only change is line 2, `(FLUIDNC POST - NOT VERIFIED ON A MACHINE)`.
  - `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/fluidnc/` (11 files): the `.nc` files add the same line 2. The `.refusal` files change only the script name and "the FluidNC post" in the warning text.
  - The two sets have the same file lists. No existing golden moved. This agrees with "Goldens moved" in the body.
- The tool change is `M5`, a Z lift, a comment, then `M0`. There is no `M6` and no `T` word. This is the safe choice when the post cannot see the YAML configuration.
- The 3040 machine has no `safe_retract`. So the lift is a work-offset `G0 Z`, not `G53 G0 Z0`. A test pins this.
- `FluidNC` is in `M3_ONLY_POSTS`, the same as `Grbl 1.1`.
- The decision file is complete. It lists each dialect point, its wiki page and what was dropped.
- The provenance comment is present. No process file changes. No new crate dependency. No UI change, so no screenshots are necessary.

Extra suites run: `example_catalog` (the diff adds a post). The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code, so the kernel STEP suites do not apply. Heavy lanes: not run. The diff does not reach them.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

1. Remove the `note("FLUIDNC POST - NOT VERIFIED ON A MACHINE")` line: `fluidnc_header_says_not_verified_on_a_machine` is red. The recorded `.nc` goldens are red too.
2. Write `T<n> M6` in place of the `M0` stop: `fluidnc_tool_change_is_a_stop_without_m6` is red.

After I restored the file, `script_fluidnc` is green again (17 passed).

## Requested before merge

1. **`crates/post/tests/script_fluidnc.rs` - the suite is in the wrong place for the current main.** #3188 (commit `bded866c7`, merged after this PR's base `e4b08e95b`) moved each post script suite into the `script_goldens` directory suite. On the trial merge, this test fails:

   ```
   recorded_streams::every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite ... FAILED
   panicked at crates/post/tests/script_goldens/recorded_streams.rs:339:70:
   fluidnc.cps has no suite .../crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_fluidnc.rs
   ```

   The same test is green when `fluidnc.cps` is removed from the tree. Thus this PR causes the failure, and bare main does not have it.

   Fix:
   - Merge `upstream/main` into the branch.
   - Move the file to `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_fluidnc.rs`.
   - Replace `#[macro_use] mod recorded;` with `use crate::recorded;`, as `script_grbl.rs` does.
   - Add `mod script_fluidnc;` to `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/main.rs`, in name order.
   - Change the regenerate line to `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_goldens script_fluidnc::`.
   - Update the PR body: the "New top-level test file" paragraph and the `script_fluidnc` binary name no longer apply.
   - Run `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_goldens` on the final tree.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The decision file says that the FluidNC wiki pages were not fetched. The "not verified" header line correctly shows this. Before an agent removes that line, a person must check each row of the table against wiki.fluidnc.com (for example the `G4 P` unit and `G91.1`).
- The 3040 values are typical values, not a maker's sheet. The machine description says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
